summary: Added an incremental, symbol-aware repository index and deterministic hybrid retrieval with path/symbol/content scoring, snapshot provenance, generated/secret exclusion, redaction, strict token-budget truncation, file/chunk limits, and an explicit context manifest. The companion now inventories the selected repository server-side through /context/search, and the portal/benchmark use that inventory instead of relying on the browser's visible eight files.

files.purpose: Incremental indexer, chunk provenance, secret/generated exclusion, hybrid retrieval and token budgeting
Retrieve relevant context before dispatch and expose contextManifest/audit provenance
Provide bounded server-side repository inventory and context retrieval
Use companion context search before browser fallback
Exclusion, chunk provenance, ranking, redaction, strict token budget and incremental reuse tests
Ground live benchmark requests with companion context

checks.summary: Build plus 64 application tests and 10 companion tests passed
Live benchmark completed one Ask run for all eight ready engines with eight non-empty repository context files
Companion indexed 196 inventory files and returned non-empty context under a 12000-token budget
Five browser tests passed with repository-grounded benchmark context

risks: The index cache is isolate-local and bounded to eight workspaces; a multi-instance deployment should move the index/chunk manifest to durable storage or a shared index service.
followUps: P1-T4 should render contextManifest provenance and token budget beside the existing benchmark metrics.
